items.context: @glassnode (611.545 seguidores), en inglés: "Bitcoin is back at its summer lows near $60K, and stocks are also in a downtrend. BTC gave back the whole NVIDIA rally in less than six hours, an indication of severe relative weakness." Enlaza su Week On-chain: capitulación, pérdidas realizadas más altas desde FTX, Realized Price en $53,2K (todo mercado bajista previo cerró bajo él). Publicado hace ~35 min: 13.573 vistas, 43 likes, 13 respuestas. Ángulo: temperatura de mercado / piso.
items.suggested_text:
The relative weakness is the part worth sitting with. When BTC gives back a risk-on bounce in hours while the Nasdaq keeps most of it, the bid isn't coming from macro; it depends on whoever is still willing to absorb supply.

Valuation is already deep in the cold zone. The market temperature index I track, 25% each of MVRV, price vs the 200-week average, drawdown from the high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days. A reading that low says most of the excess is already gone; it doesn't say the selling is over.

That's where your Realized Price point bites: every past bear closed below it, and $53.2K still sits under spot. Cold can stay cold longer than it feels like it should, and the final flush is rarely the one everyone is positioned for.
